name: Phandalin
description: A frontier town on the Triboar Trail with no guards until Sildar's new watch. It was a booming trade center centuries ago when the forge was active. Its festival ended with lanterns and fireworks.

name: Stonehill Inn
description: Toblen and Trilena Stonehill's inn and the party's usual base.

name: Shrine of Luck
description: Sister Garaele's shrine.

name: Townmaster's Hall
description: Harbin Wester's office.

name: Barthen's Provisions
description: Elmina's general store. Gundren's wagon and oxen are kept here.

name: Lion's Shield Coster
description: Lenine's weapons and armor shop. The party gets 10% off.

name: Sleeping Giant
description: Former Redbrand hangout.

name: Tresendar Manor
description: On the hill, with defensible tunnels. Was the Redbrand base. The party now holds the deed and Torra Ironwell is restoring it as their bastion.

name: Redbrand hideout
description: Cellar, cistern, barracks, cells, crevasse (the nothic's lair) and the Tresendar family crypt.

name: Drains beneath Tresendar Manor
description: Rat swarms, crushed pipes, and the flooded chamber where the aboleth died.

name: Phandalin cemetery
description: Tharden's grave, under Levon's marker.

name: Festival fairgrounds
description: A red and cream striped circus tent, food stalls and games, a carousel, Fenwick's cups, the tug of war rope and Corwin's novelty tent. The old mine road runs past one end.

name: Old Mine Road
description: Runs past one end of the fairgrounds. A fairground goat bolted from it, and a lone lantern turned against the breeze over it and winked out.

name: Tostig farm
description: Alvin's homestead, where Levon grew up.

name: Daran Edermath's orchard
description: Apples at 1 sp a basket. Mind the tree Francis replanted.

name: Cragmaw hideout
description: Klarg's cave north of the ambush site, with wolves, a flood trap and a rope bridge.

name: Triboar Trail
description: The caravan road, raided near Wyvern Tor.

name: Wyvern Tor
description: The marauder cave with an ogre, bugbears and an orc. Its wall drawing shows a crystal-headed goblin. There's an owlbear den by the broken bridge.

name: Old Owl Well
description: Hamun Kost's camp and his zombies.

name: Goblin cave near Old Owl Well
description: Where Glasstaff fled. It had wolves, raiders, a ballista and the cells holding Blue and Allyanna.

name: Conyberry
description: Home of the banshee Agatha, with a dry well.

name: Cragmaw Castle
description: Hidden northwest of the Triboar Trail in Neverwinter Wood. King Grol's seat, with a blood-soaked shrine to Lathander. The bridge gate burned.

name: Wave Echo Cave
description: A dwarf and gnome mine about 15 miles (5 hours) east of Phandalin in the Sword Mountains. It holds the Forge of Spells, the black pool and its snake, the smelter and Mormesk's quarters. Undead still roam near the forge.

name: Forge of Spells
description: A green flame that has burned for 500 years. It temporarily enchants blades and armor, and is running at about 25%.

name: Craig's goblin commune
description: A goblin farming commune with the Scraptops, guarded by the reformed bugbear captain.

name: Thundertree
description: Mirna Dendrar's family heirloom is hidden here. Not yet visited.

name: Neverwinter
description: Where Gundren hired the party, and where Vexhar ran errands in the underworld.

name: Lintri's Coral Court
description: Where Blue was held for ten years.
